title: Global Economic Indicators
dragHint: The globe rotates on its own — you can also click and drag to spin it.

intros.inflation: The latest annual CPI inflation rate by country — from the World Bank open data API. Inflation is never a live figure anywhere: statistical agencies publish this data monthly/annually with a few months' delay; every country on the globe shows its own latest published year.
intros.gdp: The latest annual GDP (gross domestic product) growth rate by country — from the World Bank open data API. This is an officially published annual figure, not a live one; every country on the globe shows its own latest published year.
intros.unemployment: The latest annual unemployment rate (as a share of the labor force) by country — from the World Bank open data API. This is an officially published annual figure, not a live one; every country on the globe shows its own latest published year.
